  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)
  • Demonstrated experience building operating programs, not just managing established workflows.
  • Strong experience defining SLAs, KPIs, and governance structures and using them to improve external-partner performance.
  • Experience with fee, invoice, or financial reconciliation processes, including investigation and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using spreadsheets, data tools, SQL, or similar tools to build reporting and identify trends.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior internal and external partners.
  • Sound judgment, strong attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
  • A builder mindset with a bias toward scalable processes, clear ownership, and AI-centric automation.
  • All applications must be submitted in English

Bonus Points

  • Experience in payment rails, banking partnerships, card networks, fintech infrastructure, or money movement.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors or regulated financial-services partners.
  • Experience with audit-ready controls, compliance requirements, and contractual-performance obligations.
  • Experience applying AI or automation to reconciliation, reporting, quality assurance, or operational workflows.

descriptionHtml:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office.We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you'll do

As Risk Counsel, you will own the legal response to the moments that matter most: disputes, incidents, collections, and regulatory inquiries. You will be the connective tissue between Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and our product teams when things go wrong, and you will drive them to resolution. Specifically, you will:

  • Manage pre-litigation matters end to end, including demand letters, disputes with customers, vendors, and counterparties, and early case assessment, working with outside counsel where escalation is warranted
  • Lead the legal resolution of account and funds ownership disputes, including competing claims to accounts, deceased or dissolved account holders, business partner separations, and interpleader-adjacent scenarios
  • Oversee the legal side of collections on delinquent commercial card and lending balances, including strategy for escalated accounts, engagement and management of collections agencies and outside counsel, and ensuring collections practices comply with applicable law and our bank partner requirements
  • Manage bankruptcy matters involving Brex customers and counterparties, including proof of claim filings, automatic stay compliance, preference and clawback exposure, and coordinating recovery strategy in Chapter 7 and Chapter 11 proceedings
  • Serve as legal lead on incidents across the company, from intake through root cause, coordinating cross-functional response and ensuring privilege is appropriately established and maintained
  • Drive remediation programs arising from incidents, including scoping affected customer populations, structuring remediation approaches, and documenting completion
  • Own legal review and strategy for customer outreach connected to incidents and remediations, including notification content, timing, and channel decisions
  • Prepare and manage responses to regulatory inquiries, examinations, and information requests related to incidents, disputes, and remediation matters, in partnership with Compliance and our bank and broker-dealer partners
  • Supervise responses to subpoenas, civil investigative demands, and other third-party legal process served on Brex, including intake, objections, negotiation of scope, coordination of document collection and production, and customer notice where required
  • Build and improve playbooks, escalation frameworks, and reporting so the company handles recurring dispute, collections, and incident types consistently and quickly
  • Advise product, operations, and support teams on reducing dispute and incident risk upstream

Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (JD) and active bar membership in good standing of at least one U.S. jurisdiction
  • 6+ years of experience as an attorney, including at least 3 years focused on one or more of the following: litigation or commercial disputes, creditors’ rights or collections, bankruptcy, regulatory investigations or enforcement, or incident response
  • Experience owning pre-litigation disputes end to end, including demand letters, early case assessment, and deciding when to bring in outside counsel
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape applicable to fintech, such as state money transmission, UDAAP, Reg E and Reg Z, BSA/AML, and bank partnership models 
  • Demonstrated ability to run a high-volume, high-stakes docket independently, with excellent judgment on what to resolve, what to escalate, and what to fight
  • Strong drafting instincts for customer-facing and regulator-facing communications, where precision and tone both matter
  • A calm, structured approach under pressure and a bias toward action and clear ownership
  • Low ego, high accountability, and comfort operating cross-functionally with Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Engineering, Product & Design

Nice to have

  • 3+ years of experience as an in-house attorney at a fintech, bank, broker-dealer, or payments company
  • Experience responding to bank regulatory examinations or inquiries, including from the OCC or the Federal Reserve
  • Broker-dealer regulatory experience, such as responding to FINRA or SEC examinations and information requests, handling FINRA customer arbitrations and complaints, Rule 4530 reporting, or advising on SEC enforcement inquiries and subpoenas
  • Experience managing collections agencies or recovery counsel, including recovery strategy in Chapter 7 and Chapter 11 proceedings
  • Experience with account ownership and beneficiary dispute frameworks
  • Experience managing subpoena and third-party legal process response, including under RFPA, GLBA, and similar financial privacy frameworks

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $270,000 - $335,000 USD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Legal at Brex

The Legal team helps the company grow responsibly, advocating for Brex and for the thousands of growing businesses we serve. We provide strategic advice and guidance to all Brex teams, protect Brex, advise on risk, and represent the company externally, negotiating with partners and interacting with regulators. Reimagining the financial system in a highly regulated environment requires creativity and resourcefulness, and we welcome the challenge.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office.We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you'll do

Reporting to the General Counsel, you will lead Brex's Regulatory Affairs function and guide the company's relationships and interactions with its federal and state regulators, including the OCC, the Federal Reserve, FINRA, and state licensing agencies. You will ensure Brex proactively responds to a changing regulatory environment and delivers on its commitments to regulators accurately and on time.

This is a role for a strong program manager as much as a regulatory expert. You will run the end-to-end regulatory engagement lifecycle: exam preparation and logistics, fulfillment of supervisory requests, coordination of responses across Legal, Compliance, Risk, and business teams, and disciplined tracking of findings, commitments, and corrective actions through to closure. You will partner closely with Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and Risk counterparts at Capital One to align supervisory strategy and ensure consistent, well-coordinated engagement with regulators across the combined organization. You will also serve as a trusted advisor to senior management, synthesizing trends across the external regulatory landscape and translating them into practical guidance and early awareness of emerging focus areas. Finally, you will help bring together cross functional teams to help drive forward proactive regulatory requirements. 

Responsibilities

  • Manage and foster productive relationships and interactions between Brex business functions and federal and state regulatory and supervisory staff
  • Lead preparation and oversee execution of regulatory exams and other supervisory engagements, including logistics management, fulfillment of supervisory and information requests, and driving timely issue resolution
  • Build and run the program management infrastructure for regulatory commitments: intake, tracking, ownership, milestones, evidence, and closure, ensuring the company delivers on commitments to regulators in a timely manner
  • Identify potential risk areas and advise on corrective actions, ensuring remediation efforts are monitored and on track for timely and effective mitigation
  • Provide thought leadership and strategic advisory support to senior management and the board regarding the regulatory environment and supervisory matters
  • Synthesize trends across the external landscape and individual regulatory engagements, driving internal awareness of focus areas and potential sensitivities so the company meets and exceeds expectations set by law, regulation, and agency guidance
  • Partner with Capital One Regulatory Affairs, Legal, and Risk teams on integration-related regulatory workstreams and coordinated supervisory engagement
  • Develop scalable processes, playbooks, and reporting (including management and board-level artifacts) that give leadership a clear, current view of regulatory posture

Requirements

  • Juris Doctor (JD) and active bar membership in good standing of the bar of at least one U.S. state
  • 8+ years of experience in banking, financial services, risk management, audit, consulting, or regulatory agencies, or a combination
  • 5+ years of experience working directly with banking regulators (e.g., OCC, Federal Reserve, FDIC, state agencies) and regulatory policy, including exam management and supervisory engagement
  • Significant experience supporting integrated projects or programs where senior leaders and external stakeholders are your customers, with demonstrated PMO discipline: structured tracking, clear ownership, and reliable follow-through
  • Working knowledge of commercial financial products (cards, payments, deposits, lending) and the associated regulatory frameworks and risk management practices
  • Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build consensus across a broad range of stakeholders
  • Ability to lead with empathy when working with internal stakeholders and government agencies
  • Comfort in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where priorities often change
  • Willingness to be a team player who pitches in to help out on other products and topics; one of our key tenets is "One Brex"

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a fintech or technology-forward financial institution operating under bank or broker-dealer supervision (OCC, Federal Reserve, FINRA, SEC)
  • Experience navigating regulatory dimensions of M&A integration between a fintech and a regulated bank
  • Familiarity with three lines of defense frameworks and enterprise risk management practices

Compensation

Partnerships at Brex:

The primary focus of the Partnerships team at Brex is to drive net new pipeline and revenue. We originate, launch, and scale partnerships across emerging distribution channels, embedded models, and other strategic bets that accelerate Brex's growth trajectory.

As Brex nears $1B in revenue, we are building a best-in-class Partnerships organization grounded in clear priorities and disciplined execution. Every member of our team directly contributes to top-line growth by expanding Brex's reach across key ecosystems, from technology platforms to financial sponsors who influence large customer networks.Within Business Development, the Private Equity Channel team is responsible for building partnerships with PE firms to drive new customer growth, generate pipeline, and increase engagement and monetization of existing customers.

Over the past 12 months, Brex's PE channel hit an inflection point, turning Tier 1 private equity firms into active referral sources for their portfolio companies due to demonstrable ROI. That model was proven through consistent in-market presence: dinners, conferences, events, and the trust that compounds across repeated value-added touchpoints. The channel is now at a critical scaling moment. With a proven playbook and a growing book of top-tier sponsor relationships, we are hiring a Director to take ownership of the entire PE channel — leading the team, sharpening the strategy, and raising the ceiling on what this channel can deliver.

What You'll Do:

We are hiring a Director, Private Equity Channel to lead and scale Brex's PE partnerships organization. Based in New York, you will own the full PE channel strategy: setting direction, managing and growing the team, holding the most senior sponsor relationships, and driving the referral engine that turns PE firms into durable, high-conviction distribution partners for Brex.

This is a player-coach role for a senior operator who has both the relationship credibility to command a room with managing directors and the management instincts to build a team around them. You will inherit a functioning playbook and existing tier 1 partners, and your mandate is to manage these key relationships while building and scaling the team.

Where You'll Work:

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:

  • Hire, develop, and manage a team of Partner Managers across East Coast, West Coast, and emerging PE geographies, setting the bar for performance and career growth
  • Own the PE channel strategy end-to-end — target firm prioritization, coverage model, engagement motion, and referral conversion — and identify new growth vectors across geographies, firm tiers, and portfolio models
  • Build the internal case for channel investment and headcount, presenting performance and roadmap to senior leadership
  • Personally own and deepen relationships with the most strategic Tier 1 PE firms, serving as escalation point and executive sponsor across the team's book
  • Represent Brex across the PE ecosystem at premier industry events, dinners, and conferences
  • Partner with Marketing on field events and content, and with Sales leadership on handoffs and referral-to-close conversion
  • Drive internal alignment with Finance, RevOps, and Partnerships on channel prioritization and metrics infrastructure during planning cycles

Requirements:

  • 8–12+ years of experience in PE business development, financial services sales, partnerships, or a related senior role with consistent, demonstrable exposure to the private equity ecosystem.
  • 4+ years of people management experience; track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing BD or sales talent.
  • Established senior-level relationships within the New York private equity community; credible with managing directors and partners at leading PE firms from day one.
  • Proven channel builder — experience standing up or significantly scaling a partnerships motion, not just maintaining one.
  • Strong commercial instincts; able to connect PE relationship activity to pipeline generation, ARR outcomes, and executive-level narratives.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; executive-ready in both internal stakeholder management and external partner engagement.
  • High organizational acumen — able to manage a team, a personal book of relationships, and strategic workstreams simultaneously without dropping quality.
  • Based in New York; comfortable being in-market regularly for dinners, events, and partner engagements.
  • Self-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate with high autonomy while maintaining tight alignment with Partnerships leadership.

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. descriptionHtml:

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

About the team

Acquisition Engineering owns the customer journey from first touch to first value: helping prospective customers discover Brex, apply, get approved, onboard quickly, and adopt more of the platform over time. The group brings together GTM Engineering, Salesforce, Onboarding, and Adoption, with a shared mission to acquire customers faster and deliver value sooner.

We operate at the intersection of customer experience, revenue, and operational scale. Our work improves funnel conversion, reduces time to first transaction, equips go-to-market teams with high-leverage systems, and creates product experiences that drive durable adoption and expansion.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to operate across Acquisition Engineering. You won’t be limited to a single team or service; your mandate is to identify the highest-impact technical opportunities across the funnel—especially the cross-team gaps that no individual team can solve alone—and drive them to durable outcomes.

This is a leadership role without direct reports. You’ll set technical direction, raise the bar for system design and execution, and multiply the effectiveness of engineers and engineering managers across the group. You’ll partner closely with Staff Engineers, product leaders, and GTM stakeholders to shape where we invest and how we deliver customer and business impact.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based inSeattle. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We require three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday—and offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and lead the most consequential technical initiatives across Acquisition Engineering, from first touch through onboarding, activation, and ongoing adoption.
  • Set technical direction for cross-team systems, including architecture, platform boundaries, reliability, and data quality.
  • Partner with GTM Engineering, Salesforce, Onboarding, and Adoption to simplify handoffs and improve end-to-end customer and operator experiences.
  • Raise the technical bar through design reviews, hands-on implementation, operational excellence, and pragmatic engineering standards.
  • Champion repeatable, secure, and high-velocity delivery across the group, including strong practices for code review, deployment safety, and operational excellence.
  • Act as a force multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, improving how teams plan and execute, and developing the next generation of technical leaders.
  • Collaborate with product, design, data, operations, and go-to-market partners to translate ambiguous business opportunities into scalable technical solutions.
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to how the group builds customer experiences, internal tooling, and engineering workflows.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership across multiple teams or a large product area.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and drive ambiguous, cross-cutting problems to resolution without a narrowly defined charter.
  • Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale backend or full-stack systems in production.
  • Strong product and business judgment, with the ability to connect technical investments to customer experience, growth, and operational outcomes.
  • Proven ability to influence across engineering, product, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong collaboration, written, and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical trade-offs to senior business and engineering stakeholders.

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

You’ll coach managers, develop exceptional talent, and build repeatable systems that drive pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and consistent deal execution. You’ll establish clear priorities and lead teams through growth and change while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration. Working across go-to-market functions, this leader will empower the organization to win competitive deals and translate successful approaches into stronger execution across the segment.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in one of our offices in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop frontline sales managers to consistently achieve Mid-Market new-business targets
  • Own segment strategy and execution, translating business priorities into clear goals, manager expectations, and measurable outcomes
  • Hire and develop exceptional sales talent, build leadership bench strength, and maintain a high bar for coaching and performance management
  • Build and scale operating cadences across outbound prospecting, account prioritization, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting
  • Use data to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize improvements, and measure their impact on pipeline quality, conversion, and sales productivity
  • Coach managers on qualification, competitive differentiation, and strategic deal execution; participate in key customer opportunities while strengthening the team’s ability to win independently
  • Partner with Sales Development, Marketing, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Product, and post-sale teams to generate pipeline, remove friction, and deliver on customer commitments
  • Lead teams through growth and change by communicating clear priorities, building commitment, and reinforcing consistent execution and accountability
  • Model ownership, urgency, humility, and a company-first mindset while contributing to broader go-to-market initiatives

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, with demonstrated success in Mid-Market or comparable upmarket environments and a consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • 3+ years of experience managing managers in a second-line sales leadership role, with measurable business results delivered through the frontline management team
  • Strong operating and analytical rigor, including experience building forecasting, pipeline management, and inspection systems that improve execution and predictability
  • Experience leading outbound-oriented sales teams and helping sellers prioritize large books of accounts while maintaining deal velocity
  • Strong sales judgment and competitive-selling experience, with the ability to coach managers through qualification, stakeholder engagement, differentiation, and complex deal decisions
  • A proven approach to hiring, coaching, and performance management, along with experience leading teams through meaningful growth or organizational change
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with examples of aligning stakeholders, navigating disagreement, and delivering shared business outcomes
  • Clear communication and sound judgment under ambiguity; comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close to customers, managers, and execution
  • Experience in fintech or spend management, selling to finance buyers, partner-led selling, or leadership spanning new business and post-sale is helpful but not required

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $343,520 - $429,400. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for designing, testing, implementing, and supporting the Salesforce PaaS/Saas at Brex. You will work closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop and deploy new business processes including: Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Account Management, IT and core business processes. We’re searching for someone with a record of success aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and implementing the solutions. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Work collaboratively with functional business units and help translate business requirements into logical technical designs; defining technical solutions in Salesforce.com to support business work processes and bring the design to life through declarative or programmatic solutions
  • Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues across departments (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, and others as needed) aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices
  • Coordinate the evaluation, scope and completion of new development requests
  • Use advanced declarative and programmatic tools to design, build, test, deploy, and support Salesforce solutions 
  • Coding and development according to current industry standards and best practices
  • Manage change management and deployment process for Salesforce code base
  • Conduct code reviews for ongoing projects to ensure high code quality and design patterns are followed

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Salesforce development with Salesforce implementations in a complex B2B environment
  • Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems and processes
  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, with the ability to build custom apps and objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work with key stakeholders across the organization; manage laterally and upward
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization
  • Familiarity with advanced Apex programming concepts including core design patterns, limits and bulk patterns, efficient and reliable trigger handling, asynchronous operations and effective unit testing
  • Experience with Salesforce APIs to integrate Salesforce with other tools and third-party applications
  • Expertise using key Salesforce core programming languages (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, HTML, XML, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, SOQL, RestAPIs)
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment techniques in Salesforce
  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

Bonus points

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Architect)
  • Experience building Slack applications and integrating with Slack
  • Experience working in a SCRUM or Agile methodology 
  • Previous non-Salesforce software engineering experience
  • University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related experience
  • Front-end development experience with HTML, CSS, and the Lightning Design System
  • Experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst

Compensation

descriptionHtml:

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

As the Manager of Broker-Dealer Operations you will ensure the execution and compliance of our daily trading activities. You’ll define the control environment for our trading function, work to strengthen judgment and documentation standards, and build the operating rhythms that keep a high-stakes monitoring function accurate, resilient, and ready to scale.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all trading activities at Brex are performed accurately and in a compliant manner.
  • Create and maintain documented processes that are auditable by various external stakeholders and regulators.
  • Build a control framework that provides extremely high confidence in the validity, accuracy, and completeness of all required trading activity.
  • Build and maintain an incident response, investigation, and remediation playbook to ensure we are prepared to respond quickly and thoroughly to any identified anomalies or errors.
  • Drive any future audit or regulatory findings to resolution in a timely manner
  • Manage escheatment processes and oversight ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Work with our Compliance function to ensure any marketing of investment options is compliant with regulation.
  • Partner closely with Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering, and external banking partners to strengthen controls, resolve issues quickly, and support operational readiness for new workflows and product changes.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in US banking operations, securities trading, or a related function within a bank, fintech, or other regulated financial services environment.
  • Series 7, 63, and 24
  • Experience with regulated high-risk money movement workflows.
  • Strong judgment, including the ability to assess risk, make sound escalation decisions, and maintain clear, audit-ready documentation.
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams such as Compliance, Legal, Product, Engineering, Treasury, Finance, or external partners to resolve issues and improve processes.
  • Experience leading through audits, incidents, regulatory exams, or high-severity operational escalations.
  • Familiarity with AML, sanctions, fraud, or transaction monitoring programs in a regulated financial environment.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn operational complexity into concise guidance, actionable feedback, and leadership-ready updates.

Bonus points

These are a plus, not a requirement. If you meet most of the qualifications above, we’d still encourage you to apply.

  • Experience managing an escheatment program
  • Experience supporting money market trading and settlement workflows.
  • Comfort querying databases (e.g., SQL) and/or AI utilizing data tools to identify trends, improve decision-making, or automate manual work.
  • Experience deploying AI into operational workflows with strong judgment on how to deploy AI effectively in a control heavy environment.
  • Exposure to working with external banking partners, vendors, or fintech infrastructure providers to improve operational workflows and controls.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $108,400 - $135,600  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

descriptionHtml:

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.


What you’ll do

As a Senior Sourcer II, you’ll own sourcing strategy across multiple engineering teams and the orgs behind them, partnering directly with Directors and VPs to define what great looks like before a search opens. You’ll set the talent mapping and market research approach for the orgs you support and win stakeholder buy-in.

You’ll also raise the bar past your own requisitions: honing the team’s pitch, building engagement resources other sourcers adopt, closing gaps in how we source, and mentoring people growing into this work. This is a role for someone who has outgrown running excellent searches alone and wants their judgment to shape how an entire team searches.


Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Own sourcing strategy for multiple teams and the orgs behind them, typically partnering with several Directors or VPs.
  • Define and implement talent mapping and market research for the orgs you support, and secure stakeholder buy-in for the approach.
  • Autonomously scope and land ambiguous projects across the team, identifying risks early and mitigating them before they surface.
  • Own and evolve the team’s pitch and build engagement resources other sourcers adopt.
  • Coach hiring managers on what the ideal profile looks like for the next stage of their organization, and propose additional assessments or panelists where a loop has gaps.
  • Use reporting to diagnose complex hiring problems and drive the resulting changes through.
  • Define and modify interview processes to lift conversion or reduce time to fill.
  • Continuously hone the team’s pitch and create engagement resources other sourcers adopt.
  • Mentor sourcers and enable others to mentor, acting as the go-to expert on the team.

Requirements

  • A track record owning sourcing across multiple teams or a whole org, not a set of individual requisitions.
  • Experience partnering directly with Director- and VP-level stakeholders, including influencing what they search for rather than only executing it.
  • Fluent enough in comp bands and candidate motivation to pre-qualify early and reset unrealistic expectations before a candidate enters a loop.
  • Has changed how a team sources — a process, a tool, a pitch, a pipeline — and can show what moved as a result.
  • Has mentored sourcers or recruiters, and can point to people who grew because of it.
  • Deep technical market knowledge across engineering, data, product and AI, including where the talent actually sits.
  • Fluent in modern sourcing and CRM tooling, and comfortable using data to argue for a change in direction.

Bonus points

  • Experience building a sourcing function, playbook, or onboarding path from scratch.
  • Experience owning a team’s sourcing metrics and reporting them to leadership.
  • Experience sourcing for AI/ML, agentic AI, or other emerging technical domains.
  • Experience sourcing across multiple geographies (e.g., US, Canada, LATAM).
  • Experience contributing to employer branding, talent marketing, or community-building initiatives.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $156,392 - $195,490. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

What you’ll do

The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.

As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.
  • Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.
  • Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.
  • Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.
  • Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.
  • Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.
  • Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.

Requirements

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.
  • You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.
  • You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.
  • You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.
  • You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.
  • You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.
  • You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.

Bonus points

  • You have worked on identity and access management, authentication, authorization, or audit systems in a production environment.
  • You have hands-on experience with Okta, Oso, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, or WebAuthn.
  • You have experience building enterprise-facing admin controls, authorization platforms, delegated access flows, or audit trails.
  • You have worked on platform teams that provide shared infrastructure, paved roads, or secure-by-default frameworks for other engineering teams.

Compensation:

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Operational AI
descriptionHtml:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you'll do
Brex's AI strategy has three pillars: Product AI builds AI into the products our customers use, Corporate AI gives every employee AI tools to work faster, and Operational AI builds the AI that runs the company. The Operational AI team owns the AI systems and internal platforms that make Brex's operations AI-native, from onboarding and KYC automation to AI-powered customer support. We're a small team with a large surface area, and our work directly shapes how fast Brex can onboard, serve, and grow its customers.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you'll focus on Agents Platform, Brex's internal platform for building, evaluating, and running AI agents in production. It already powers critical automations in customer onboarding and AI tools for our sales and customer success teams. You'll own its technical direction, help it evolve from simple workflows into agents that take action, and make it the default way Brex ships AI into its operations.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week: Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities
  • Own the technical direction and roadmap of Agents Platform, partnering with Operational AI leadership and the teams that build on it to decide what the platform should do next.
  • Design and build new platform capabilities, including tool calling, multi-step agent loops, multi-turn and conversational execution, and secure access to internal Brex data and services.
  • Evolve the evaluation and quality system, from datasets and labeling to run comparison and regression testing, so teams can measure and improve non-deterministic systems with production-grade rigor.
  • Strengthen the reliability, security, and observability of systems in business-critical flows like customer onboarding, including durable async and batch execution, authorization, cost attribution, and incident response.
  • Partner with engineering, operations, and go-to-market teams to launch and scale high-impact agents, translating how they work into clear platform requirements.
  • Drive adoption by making the platform easy to build on through clear contracts, paved roads, documentation, and AI-native developer workflows.
  • Mentor engineers on the team and across Brex through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing, and help grow the team's technical bench.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of designing, building, and operating reliable production backend systems.
  • Deep, hands-on experience using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor in your daily work, with the judgment to ship faster without lowering the quality bar.
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered systems to production, beyond prototypes: orchestrating model calls, enforcing structured outputs, and evaluating quality over time.
  • Experience with distributed and asynchronous systems and the reliability concerns that come with them, such as retries, idempotency, backpressure, and observability.
  • A platform mindset: you've built shared infrastructure, developer tooling, or paved roads that other engineers adopt, and you care about developer experience and secure-by-default design.
  • High ownership and operational excellence, including on-call, incident response, and owning systems end to end.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, and the judgment to prioritize across many internal customers, including non-engineers. English proficiency is required, as interviews will be conducted in English.
Bonus points
  • Experience building eval frameworks, LLM gateways, or agent platforms used by other teams.
  • Experience with Temporal or another durable workflow engine.
  • Experience with service and agent authorization, such as RBAC, scoped credentials, or agents acting on behalf of users.
  • Production experience with tool use, MCP, retrieval, or agentic loops.
  • A background in ML engineering, MLOps, or data infrastructure.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated environment, where auditability and model governance matter.

The Brex Rotational Program

Throughout this 18-20 month program, you'll rotate through two of our G&A teams, learning about areas such as risk management, finance, automation, and data analysis. You'll contribute to critical process improvements and developments, implementing our processes while leveraging AI to streamline workflows and enhance decision-making.

You'll challenge the status quo, bringing insights from each rotation to the next to improve cross-team communication and efficiency. We believe in a founder mindset — and this program is designed to show you how you can take ownership of your growth. During each rotation, you'll complete a core project focused on key data insights, process implementation, or process improvement—many of which will involve exploring and applying AI solutions. You'll then have the opportunity to share your findings with your program class and Brex Executives.

The program is supported by our leadership team, and you'll have frequent meetings with various Brex leaders. This provides a unique opportunity to work closely with and learn from executives who are at the forefront of building an AI-native company.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Handle day-to-day tasks efficiently.
  • Analyze business inefficiencies and propose process improvements to leadership, leveraging AI to drive solutions.
  • Work cross-functionally with various teams to streamline processes and create AI-powered workflows that improve automation and decision-making.
  • Collaborate with EPD, G&A, GTM, and Legal to translate business needs into practical automation solutions.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategy for Brex's AI-native roadmap, exploring and integrating new tools and frameworks to enhance internal operations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools and applying effective prompting skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working through ambiguity.
  • Passion for business operations, internal tools, and the application of AI and automation to improve efficiency and enable scale.
  • Proven ability to work both independently and in cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly and effectively.
  • Desire to contribute in a fast-paced environment with a founding team member mindset.

Bonus Points 

  • Major, minor, or coursework in a field relevant to AI and data, such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Information Systems, or other Engineering.
  • Basic knowledge or proficiency in  programming languages such as but not limited to Python, JavaScript, or SQL.
  • Experience with personal projects, a portfolio of work, or participation in competitions (e.g., Hackathons) focused on AI, machine learning, or data analysis.
  • Leadership roles in university clubs or organizations related to data science, AI, computer science, or business analytics.
  • Prior internships/full-time roles in an operational, data, or technical role, especially where you were involved in process improvement or automation.
  • Familiarity with Retool, Salesforce, Hex, and Looker.

Compensations

The expected salary range for this role is C$63,286 - $75,000 CAD.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue for Brex and every member of our team directly affects our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current customers. Our winning culture recognizes big team wins and celebrates individual accomplishments. We ensure that top performers are recognized and have built a competitive environment to motivate and unify the team

What you'll do

As a Startup & VC Partnerships Manager, you'll be the face of Brex in the startup ecosystem. You'll build trusted relationships with top-tier VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and high-growth founders, and turn those relationships into a steady stream of new customers.

The role has two sides that reinforce each other. On the community side, you'll represent Brex in the market by hosting events, driving engagement, and creating meaningful connections that bring real value to founders. On the partnerships side, you'll identify and cultivate partners from the ground up, build tailored go-to-market plans for each one, onboard them into the Brex ecosystem, and manage the relationship over time.

Success will be measured by your ability to bring in new startups, grow Brex's market share among top venture networks, develop new channel relationships, and deliver high-quality experiences that strengthen Brex's position in the startup space. If you have a track record of exceeding targets and a passion for building mutually beneficial relationships, this is a chance to make a significant impact in a fast-growing environment.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Sales and pipeline

  • Drive top-of-funnel customer acquisition for newly incorporated, Pre-seed through Series B companies through direct sales, strategic partnerships, relationship building, and high-impact community events

  • Consistently hit targets by converting partner relationships into a steady stream of client referrals

  • Serve as a product expert, articulating Brex's value proposition to partners and founders

Partnerships

  • Identify, cultivate, and deepen relationships with high-potential VCs, accelerators, incubators, law firms, and other ecosystem partners

  • Craft and implement tailored go-to-market strategies for each partner

  • Facilitate smooth onboarding of new partners and their teams, and be the connective tissue between partners and the Brex ecosystem

  • Conduct regular performance reviews with key partners and use the data to optimize each relationship

Community and brand

  • Expand your existing network of top-tier founders and VCs who are eager to support your efforts

  • Launch initiatives that bring founders and VCs together in meaningful and differentiated ways

  • Be the respected brand and face of Brex for Startups. You are the flag bearer for Brex and everyone should know you in the market

Value add to founders

  • Leverage your network, your colleagues' networks, and your skills to help founders on several fronts: accessing capital (debt and equity), sourcing talent for key roles, and connecting them with potential customers

Cross-functional and operations

  • Work closely with marketing, growth, direct sales, underwriting, operations, finance, revenue operations, and product & engineering to drive co-marketing opportunities, onboard new clients, and inform the product roadmap

  • Maintain strong data hygiene in Salesforce and leverage tools such as Hex, Retool, Scratchpad, Botdog, Rings, Harmonic, Pitchbook and Nooks

  • Use AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Granola, etc.) to work more efficiently

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in venture capital, at a startup, or in a partnerships or closing sales role

  • Established network within the startup ecosystem and proven experience working directly with VCs and founders

  • Strong understanding of the venture community and how to drive partnerships within it

  • Demonstrated track record of consistently hitting targets and quotas

  • Experience building communities both virtually and in person, with a passion for events and activations with partners

  • Ability to deliver tailored, consultative solutions that align with partners' needs and business goals

  • Ability to evaluate partnership performance, identify areas for optimization, and implement data-driven solutions

  • Proven ability to build trust and credibility with internal and external stakeholders

  • Self-starter with strong leadership skills, intellectual curiosity, a collaborative mindset, high EQ, and a positive, winning attitude

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is USD $135,600 - $169,500. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance. Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and every team member directly impacts our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in execution, transparency, and collaboration.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Director of Sales for the Mid-Market segment, you will lead Brex’s Mid-Market organization, overseeing four frontline sales leaders and ~20 Account Executives. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, you’ll own segment performance, develop the management team, and shape the strategy and operating cadences that support the organization’s next phase of growth.

This is a second-line leadership role that combines strategic planning with hands-on sales leadership. You’ll coach managers, develop exceptional talent, and build repeatable systems that drive pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and consistent deal execution. You’ll establish clear priorities and lead teams through growth and change while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration. Working across go-to-market functions, this leader will empower the organization to win competitive deals and translate successful approaches into stronger execution across the segment.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in one of our offices in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop frontline sales managers to consistently achieve Mid-Market new-business targets
  • Own segment strategy and execution, translating business priorities into clear goals, manager expectations, and measurable outcomes
  • Hire and develop exceptional sales talent, build leadership bench strength, and maintain a high bar for coaching and performance management
  • Build and scale operating cadences across outbound prospecting, account prioritization, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting
  • Use data to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize improvements, and measure their impact on pipeline quality, conversion, and sales productivity
  • Coach managers on qualification, competitive differentiation, and strategic deal execution; participate in key customer opportunities while strengthening the team’s ability to win independently
  • Partner with Sales Development, Marketing, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Product, and post-sale teams to generate pipeline, remove friction, and deliver on customer commitments
  • Lead teams through growth and change by communicating clear priorities, building commitment, and reinforcing consistent execution and accountability
  • Model ownership, urgency, humility, and a company-first mindset while contributing to broader go-to-market initiatives

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, with demonstrated success in Mid-Market or comparable upmarket environments and a consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • 3+ years of experience managing managers in a second-line sales leadership role, with measurable business results delivered through the frontline management team
  • Strong operating and analytical rigor, including experience building forecasting, pipeline management, and inspection systems that improve execution and predictability
  • Experience leading outbound-oriented sales teams and helping sellers prioritize large books of accounts while maintaining deal velocity
  • Strong sales judgment and competitive-selling experience, with the ability to coach managers through qualification, stakeholder engagement, differentiation, and complex deal decisions
  • A proven approach to hiring, coaching, and performance management, along with experience leading teams through meaningful growth or organizational change
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with examples of aligning stakeholders, navigating disagreement, and delivering shared business outcomes
  • Clear communication and sound judgment under ambiguity; comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close to customers, managers, and execution
  • Experience in fintech or spend management, selling to finance buyers, partner-led selling, or leadership spanning new business and post-sale is helpful but not required

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $343,520 - $429,400. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for designing, testing, implementing, and supporting the Salesforce PaaS/Saas at Brex. You will work closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop and deploy new business processes including: Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Account Management, IT and core business processes. We’re searching for someone with a record of success aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and implementing the solutions. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Work collaboratively with functional business units and help translate business requirements into logical technical designs; defining technical solutions in Salesforce.com to support business work processes and bring the design to life through declarative or programmatic solutions
  • Participate in cross-functional teams that address strategic business issues across departments (Marketing, Sales, Operations, Support, and others as needed) aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices
  • Coordinate the evaluation, scope and completion of new development requests
  • Use advanced declarative and programmatic tools to design, build, test, deploy, and support Salesforce solutions 
  • Coding and development according to current industry standards and best practices
  • Manage change management and deployment process for Salesforce code base
  • Conduct code reviews for ongoing projects to ensure high code quality and design patterns are followed

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in Salesforce development with Salesforce implementations in a complex B2B environment
  • Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems and processes
  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, with the ability to build custom apps and objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work with key stakeholders across the organization; manage laterally and upward
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization
  • Familiarity with advanced Apex programming concepts including core design patterns, limits and bulk patterns, efficient and reliable trigger handling, asynchronous operations and effective unit testing
  • Experience with Salesforce APIs to integrate Salesforce with other tools and third-party applications
  • Expertise using key Salesforce core programming languages (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, HTML, XML, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, SOQL, RestAPIs)
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment techniques in Salesforce
  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

Bonus points

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Architect)
  • Experience building Slack applications and integrating with Slack
  • Experience working in a SCRUM or Agile methodology 
  • Previous non-Salesforce software engineering experience
  • University or College Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related experience
  • Front-end development experience with HTML, CSS, and the Lightning Design System
  • Experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $240,000 - $300,000. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. title: Underwriting Analyst
descriptionHtml:

Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

What you'll do

As an Underwriting Analyst, your goal is to support our underwriting processes for our card products and grow your skills as a credit professional. This is a role that requires strong communication, time management, financial analysis, and teamwork. You will partner cross-functionally with our Sales, Customer Experience, Engineering, and Product teams to contribute to meeting organizational goals, and will have the opportunity to develop into more senior credit responsibilities over time.

Responsibilities 

  • Own and work assigned cash-based underwriting queues, including account reviews, limit changes, and credit-related requests.
  • Evaluate customer creditworthiness and repayment capacity using bank statements, transaction data, cash-flow trends, and other business information.
  • Analyze cash balances, revenue, burn, runway, utilization, and transaction activity to identify evolving credit risk.
  • Make sound, risk-based recommendations within delegated authority, balancing customer impact with responsible exposure management.
  • Clearly communicate underwriting decisions, rationale, and information requirements to internal partners and, when needed, customers.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Experience, Credit Policy, Risk, Data, Product, and Engineering to resolve complex cases and improve the end-to-end credit experience
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve underwriting quality, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Use data, spreadsheets, and AI-enabled tools to streamline routine work and surface actionable insights.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve tools and workflows that support cash-based underwriting.

Requirements

  • Passionate about credit and underwriting decisions on commercial exposures for small to large businesses
  • Strong analytical rigor and attention to details
  • Customer centric and passionate about thinking through customer needs and working with them while balancing risk exposures
  • Ability to communicate technical problems in an elegant and tactful way

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with quantitative credit risk models, probability of default (PD), and loss given default (LGD) concepts
  • Familiarity with underwriting or credit-risk tooling and workflows.
  • Experience using SQL, Hex, spreadsheets, or similar tools to analyze data and identify trends.
  • Familiarity with banking regulations and global markets
  • Experience using Salesforce or comparable case-management tools

descriptionHtml:

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

You'll lead the Product Operations team and own the operational readiness for Brex's product launches: the enablement that must be in place before a customer ever touches a new feature. You'll also own Brex's product knowledge, the Help Center, and our internal knowledge base, plus the measurement that tells us whether it lands.

This is a role for someone who combines product manager, data, and operations skills and behaviors. You'll inherit a team that has already automated a large share of its own workflow, with a suite of production agents running much of the recurring work. Your job is not only to keep that running, but to push it further: expand what AI carries and reinvest the capacity it frees into the judgment work only people can do. We want to raise our evidence bar by using key metrics to hold ourselves accountable, focus on where the impact is greatest, and celebrate our wins. We treat AI as leverage, not as a deliverable, and we measure it by how it improves our efficiency and the quality of our deliverables.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities:

Launch readiness and enablement

  • Own launch readiness, ensuring documentation, release notes, training, and tooling are ready for each release. Adapt processes and team capacity as EPD’s release cadence evolves.
  • Lead and improve OLAB, the weekly cross-functional board that assesses launch impact and aligns teams on readiness.
  • Engage early in launches, using customer and product insights to shape the product experience.
  • Lead customer-facing escalations and crisis response, establishing a single source of truth, coordinating communications, and running retrospectives.

Documentation and product knowledge

  • Own the lifecycle and quality of product documentation, keeping Help Center articles, internal knowledge, service descriptions, and implementation guides accurate, current, and clear.
  • Partner with leadership and Engineering to structure and maintain product knowledge for people and AI systems.
  • Turn AI support agent failure patterns into documentation improvements, with human validation of every AI-suggested change.

Data and automation

  • Define actionable metrics for self-service, chatbot containment, knowledge adoption, and queue health, with clear thresholds, owners, and responses.
  • Expand team automation and set standards for effective AI use, including where human judgment remains essential.

Team and cross-functional leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of four product-domain owners, setting clear expectations and managing performance and career growth.
  • Partner across product and customer-facing teams to deliver accurate, timely enablement, balancing readiness with delivery speed and making practical trade-offs.
  • Communicate performance and strategy to CX leadership and executives, translating data into clear insights that drive decisions.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, or a related function, ideally in fast-paced tech or fintech.
  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering through full launch cycles, with confidence navigating scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
  • Experience leading projects, mentoring teammates, or developing others. First-time managers are welcome.
  • Proven ability to scale cross-functional processes and influence partner teams without formal authority.
  • Experience owning documentation or knowledge at scale, maintaining quality as products evolve.
  • Strong analytical skills, including defining metrics, building useful dashboards, and using data to prioritize.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI agents and automation into workflows, with measurable improvements in efficiency or outcomes.
  • Clear, precise communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including presenting data to leadership.
  • Sound prioritization under competing demands and adaptability as processes and business needs change.

Bonus points

  • Background in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.
  • Experience as a Product Manager.
  • 1+ years managing or developing a team of 3+ individual contributors.
  • Familiarity with structuring and maintaining product knowledge for AI systems at scale.
  • Experience with self-service and containment metrics.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Linear, Guru, Sanity, and Hex.
  • Experience running cross-functional governance forums or advisory boards.
  • A track record of turning operational insights into product roadmap changes.

descriptionHtml:
