Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story, turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you'll do

You will lead the systems, data, and operations that turn demand into qualified sales conversations and help Marketing make better investment decisions. Your operating mandate runs from lead capture through qualified meetings; your measurement mandate extends through pipeline and closed revenue.

Partnering with the Senior Director of Growth Marketing, you will build the team and set the technical roadmap for a more reliable, scalable funnel across enterprise sales and self-serve motions, including Brex and Capital One integrations.

In your first year, you will establish baselines and targets with Growth Marketing, Revenue Operations, and SDR leadership to improve meaningful follow-up, routing accuracy, qualified meetings, and meeting-to-opportunity conversion, while building trusted funnel data and faster campaign delivery.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our hubs: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Salt Lake City, or Vancouver. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end marketing funnel from demand capture through sales handoff, including qualification, enrichment, scoring, routing, automation, and measurement.
  • Partner with SDR, RevOps, Product, Engineering, and Data Science to improve funnel throughput, speed-to-lead, conversion, and reliability.
  • Design scalable workflows across sales-led and self-serve motions, including emerging Capital One lead sources.
  • Own the marketing technology ecosystem and integrations across Marketo, Salesforce, LeanData, web/CMS, analytics, advertising, and other GTM platforms.
  • Set the architecture and operating standards that ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and connected.
  • Lead major platform improvements and evaluate new capabilities, including CDP and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Own the quality and governance of marketing and prospect data, including identity, enrichment, segmentation, taxonomy, and attribution.
  • Establish trusted funnel and performance measurement in partnership with RevOps, Finance, Data, and Engineering.
  • Translate data into recommendations that improve marketing efficiency, sales handoffs, and investment decisions.
  • Lead and develop the Marketing Operations team while establishing clear priorities, operating rhythms, service levels, and accountability.
  • Build scalable processes for intake, prioritization, capacity planning, documentation, and execution.
  • Serve as a highly autonomous thought partner to Growth Marketing leadership and drive alignment across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Product, Engineering, and Finance.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or growth operations, including 3+ years leading and developing a team.
  • Measurable improvements to lead-to-meeting conversion, with experience supporting both enterprise sales and self-serve or product-led motions.
  • Deep hands-on architecture experience in Marketo or an equivalent marketing automation platform, plus strong Salesforce fluency and shared platform ownership with Revenue Operations.
  • Experience designing scalable lifecycle, scoring, routing, campaign taxonomy, and data governance practices.
  • Strong measurement judgment, including understanding attribution limitations, plus SQL and BI fluency to investigate performance independently.
  • A track record of using pipeline or forecast models to inform decisions and aligning cross-functional partners on execution.
  • Experience managing martech vendors and increasing team capacity through automation and reusable processes.
  • Experience running marketing systems as production infrastructure, including monitoring, incident response, and change control on revenue-facing workflows.
  • Experience running intake and prioritization for a team serving many internal stakeholders, with capacity planning that holds up under pressure.

Bonus points

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment.
  • Technical partnership with Product and Engineering on signup flows or identity resolution.
  • Experience with holdouts, incrementality testing, or media mix modeling.
  • Experience with marketing financial planning and reporting.
  • AI or agent-assisted workflows with measurable results.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanData, Qualified, Hex, a customer data platform, or integration and workflow tools such as Retool.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $185,320 - $231,650. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate's location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

What you’ll do

As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for designing, testing, implementing, and supporting the Salesforce PaaS/Saas at Brex. You will work closely with functional leaders, organizational units, and subject matter experts to identify, develop and deploy new business processes including: Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Account Management, IT and core business processes. We’re searching for someone with a record of success aligning business processes with Salesforce best practices, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and implementing the solutions. 

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Responsibilities

  • Work collaboratively with functional business units and help translate business requirements into logical technical designs; defining technical solutions in Salesforce.com to support business work processes and bring the design to life through declarative or programmatic solutions

  • Coordinate the evaluation, scope and completion of new development requests
  • Use advanced declarative and programmatic tools to design, build, test, deploy, and support Salesforce solutions

  • Conduct code reviews for ongoing projects to ensure high code quality and design patterns are followed

Requirements

  • Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and all upstream and downstream applications, systems and processes
  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, with the ability to build custom apps and objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills with the ability to work with key stakeholders across the organization; manage laterally and upward
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse people and individuals at various levels within the organization
  • Familiarity with advanced Apex programming concepts including core design patterns, limits and bulk patterns, efficient and reliable trigger handling, asynchronous operations and effective unit testing
  • Experience with Salesforce APIs to integrate Salesforce with other tools and third-party applications
  • Expertise using key Salesforce core programming languages (Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, HTML, XML, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, SOQL, RestAPIs)
  • Experience with CI/CD and deployment techniques in Salesforce
  • English proficiency/fluency, both written and speaking (note: interviews will be conducted in English)

  • Experience working in a SCRUM or Agile methodology

  • Front-end development experience with HTML, CSS, and the Lightning Design System
  • Experience as a Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you'll do

As a Fraud Strategy Associate, you’ll own the end-to-end integrity of Brex’s fraud and risk ecosystem across credit, deposit, and card payment rails. You'll find patterns, trace root causes, and build the detection logic, automations, and reporting that keep fraud in check without adding friction for customers. You’ll design your own solutions, see fraud across every product vertical, and partner with Risk, Data Science, Engineering, and Product to build prevention into the product itself. 

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

Strategic Analysis & Detection

  • Data Mining: Use SQL and Python to mine large-scale data, and apply LLM-based tools to detect and automate the identification of fraudulent patterns across credit, deposit, and card payment rails.
  • Vendor and Rule Optimization: Design and refine automated detection logic to proactively mitigate risk while maintaining a frictionless experience for legitimate customers.
  • Emerging Threat Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends and regulatory shifts to rapidly deploy new defensive strategies against novel fraud vectors.

Operational Excellence & Process Ownership

  • Workflow Architecture: optimize the internal processes for fraud investigations, ensuring operational discipline, case visibility, and high-fidelity documentation.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the strategic bridge between Risk Leadership, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, and Product teams to integrate fraud-prevention infrastructure into the core product lifecycle.
  • Tooling & Infrastructure: Define and manage the technical requirements for internal AI-driven tools and third-party risk-reduction platforms.

Metrics, Reporting & Performance

  • KPI Management: Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as false positive rates, fraud capture rates, and operational turnaround times.
  • Executive Dashboards: Build and maintain scalable reporting suites to provide real-time visibility into fraud exposure and program effectiveness for senior stakeholders.
  • Impact Assessment: Conduct deep-dive post-mortems on fraud incidents to quantify financial impact and recommend structural process improvements.

Requirements

  • Technical Mastery: Capable with SQL and/or Python for data wrangling, statistical modeling, and automation.
  • Industry Experience: 3+ years of experience in fraud strategy, risk operations, or data-driven business operations within a financial services or high-growth fintech environment.
  • Operational Mindset: Proven ability to build scalable processes and manage complex projects from data exploration through to operational rollout.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex analytical findings into clear, executive-level strategic narratives.

Bonus Points

  • Advanced Certification: Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) designation.
  • Experience with Snowflake, Salesforce, and data visualization platforms like Hex.
  • Experience managing fraud risk and operational workflows for products spanning multiple geographic jurisdictions.
  • Experience utilizing AI tools to enhance internal operational efficiency.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $95,040 - $118,800.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

title: Senior Director, Mid Market Sales
locations: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
descriptionHtml:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and every team member directly impacts our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in execution, transparency, and collaboration.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Director of Sales for the Mid-Market segment, you will lead Brex’s Mid-Market organization, overseeing four frontline sales leaders and ~20 Account Executives. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, you’ll own segment performance, develop the management team, and shape the strategy and operating cadences that support the organization’s next phase of growth.

This is a second-line leadership role that combines strategic planning with hands-on sales leadership. You’ll coach managers, develop exceptional talent, and build repeatable systems that drive pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and consistent deal execution. You’ll establish clear priorities and lead teams through growth and change while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, and collaboration. Working across go-to-market functions, this leader will empower the organization to win competitive deals and translate successful approaches into stronger execution across the segment.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in one of our offices in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, or Salt Lake City. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop frontline sales managers to consistently achieve Mid-Market new-business targets
  • Own segment strategy and execution, translating business priorities into clear goals, manager expectations, and measurable outcomes
  • Hire and develop exceptional sales talent, build leadership bench strength, and maintain a high bar for coaching and performance management
  • Build and scale operating cadences across outbound prospecting, account prioritization, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, and forecasting
  • Use data to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize improvements, and measure their impact on pipeline quality, conversion, and sales productivity
  • Coach managers on qualification, competitive differentiation, and strategic deal execution; participate in key customer opportunities while strengthening the team’s ability to win independently
  • Partner with Sales Development, Marketing, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Product, and post-sale teams to generate pipeline, remove friction, and deliver on customer commitments
  • Lead teams through growth and change by communicating clear priorities, building commitment, and reinforcing consistent execution and accountability
  • Model ownership, urgency, humility, and a company-first mindset while contributing to broader go-to-market initiatives

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, with demonstrated success in Mid-Market or comparable upmarket environments and a consistent record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
  • 3+ years of experience managing managers in a second-line sales leadership role, with measurable business results delivered through the frontline management team
  • Strong operating and analytical rigor, including experience building forecasting, pipeline management, and inspection systems that improve execution and predictability
  • Experience leading outbound-oriented sales teams and helping sellers prioritize large books of accounts while maintaining deal velocity
  • Strong sales judgment and competitive-selling experience, with the ability to coach managers through qualification, stakeholder engagement, differentiation, and complex deal decisions
  • A proven approach to hiring, coaching, and performance management, along with experience leading teams through meaningful growth or organizational change
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with examples of aligning stakeholders, navigating disagreement, and delivering shared business outcomes
  • Clear communication and sound judgment under ambiguity; comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close to customers, managers, and execution
  • Experience in fintech or spend management, selling to finance buyers, partner-led selling, or leadership spanning new business and post-sale is helpful but not required

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $343,520 - $429,400. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and every team member directly impacts our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in execution, transparency, and collaboration.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Director, Enterprise Client Sales, you will lead Brex’s enterprise client sales organization, developing its Directors and building the team responsible for retention, card growth, and SaaS expansion across our largest customers. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, you will own segment performance and define a multi-product growth strategy for our enterprise customer base.

This second-line leadership role combines organization building with enterprise sales strategy. You will build and scale a team capable of selling new products to new buying groups within existing customers and telling a unified platform story across card, travel, and expense. You will strengthen the executive relationships, business reviews, qualification, business cases, and ROI needed to support new enterprise buying decisions.

You will translate strategy into clear account priorities, coverage decisions, manager expectations, and operating practices. Working closely with Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Revenue Operations, you will coordinate the account teams and executive engagement needed to deliver customer and revenue outcomes. You will also bring a strong understanding of product capabilities and customer needs, helping prioritize the gaps that materially affect enterprise expansion.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in one of our offices in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities

  • Own Enterprise Net Revenue performance across retention and expansion, with clear accountability for card growth, SaaS adoption, gross retention, and churn prevention
  • Define and execute a multi-product enterprise growth strategy, prioritizing opportunities across products, buying teams, business units, and geographies
  • Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Client Sales Directors, establishing clear expectations for hiring, seller development, account strategy, forecasting, and performance management
  • Build and scale the organization through thoughtful hiring, onboarding, and ramp plans that reflect customer opportunity and management capacity
  • Build a repeatable cross-sell motion across card, travel, and expense, enabling teams to identify new buying groups, develop champions, articulate platform value, and secure new product commitments within existing customers
  • Establish disciplined account coverage, prioritization, assignment, planning, pipeline inspection, renewal planning, and forecasting practices, with clear ownership and accountability across account teams
  • Coach Directors and their teams to lead executive business reviews, develop C-suite relationships, communicate a unified platform and product-roadmap story, and build credible business cases and ROI for expansion opportunities
  • Build a structured executive engagement program that connects Brex leaders with priority customers, with clear objectives, preparation, account-team responsibilities, and follow-through
  • Establish an effective shared-account operating model with Customer Success, aligning responsibilities for retention risk, expansion opportunities, renewal planning, customer engagement, and value delivery
  • Develop a prioritized view of product gaps blocking enterprise expansion. Challenge and refine requests with the sales organization, distinguish critical capabilities from desirable additions, and bring a focused, evidence-based set of priorities to Product
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success to align commercial commitments with product capabilities, implementation readiness, adoption, and customer outcomes
  • Work with Revenue Operations and Enablement to improve revenue visibility, manager effectiveness, and the team’s ability to sell across card and SaaS products
  • Build a culture of ownership, high standards, collaboration, and accountability while developing leaders who can sustain performance as the organization grows

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, including substantial enterprise software experience and a demonstrated record of delivering revenue results
  • 3+ years of experience managing frontline sales leaders in a second-line leadership role, with measurable results delivered through the management team
  • Demonstrated success building or materially scaling sales organizations, including recruiting strong talent, developing managers, and establishing effective onboarding and ramp practices
  • Experience defining a commercial growth strategy and translating it into account priorities, coverage decisions, manager expectations, and measurable outcomes
  • Strong enterprise sales judgment and a clear approach to multi-product cross-selling, including new buying groups, executive business reviews, C-suite relationships, business cases, and complex decision and procurement processes
  • Expertise in MEDDIC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the ability to coach leaders on qualification, champion development, business-value articulation, and ROI
  • Strong operating and analytical rigor in coordinating enterprise account teams, establishing executive engagement and account-planning frameworks, assigning ownership, and holding teams accountable for customer and revenue outcomes
  • Strong product fluency and sufficient technical depth to understand capabilities and constraints, assess the commercial significance of product gaps, and prioritize critical expansion requirements with Product and sales stakeholders
  • Effective cross-functional leadership, including substantive partnership with Customer Success and teams responsible for implementation, adoption, and customer value delivery
  • Clear communication, executive credibility, and the ability to align senior stakeholders and internal account teams around shared priorities, decisions, and follow-through
  • Experience leading both enterprise new business and existing-customer growth is particularly valuable. Enterprise new-business leaders should demonstrate a strong approach to executive business reviews, CSM partnership, and cross-selling within existing accounts. Experience in fintech, spend management, or selling to Finance organizations is helpful

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams span Software, Data, Security, and IT, and operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration. We tackle hard technical problems, own our outcomes, and push for excellence at every level — from architecture to deployment. It's an environment where engineering is a craft, and builders become leaders.

What you’ll do

Building world-class financial services requires world-class security. As a GRC Engineer on the Trust team, you will work on high-impact cross-organization governance, risk, and compliance initiatives. You’d advocate for security across the company and scale Trust efforts while executing hands-on yourself.

GRC’s mission is to instill trust in Brex from our customers, regulators, partners, and workforce in order to enable the company’s continued growth by maturing our security posture, maintaining compliance, optimizing security practices, and mitigating enterprise risk. We serve as the business side of Trust, and of Compliance as the what, Governance as the how, and Risk as the why, of Trust. 

Where you'll work

This role will be based in our São Paulo office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of 3 days per week in the office - Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

The GRC team handles a wide range of cross-functional activities from security compliance certifications and audits to risk management, vendor reviews, inbound due diligence, security education, access control, policy and procedures, and many more. Each of these ongoing parallel activities entails interpreting and setting requirements, assessing the effectiveness of security controls, risk-based decision making, cross-functional collaboration and communication, and staying up-to-date on security best practices and how changes in the evolving threat landscape need to inform our strategy. We always strive to go above and beyond industry standards in every aspect of GRC while keeping a balance with supporting the business’s goals. GRC is responsible for key programs that allow us to pass our audit requirements and underpin our risk management mandate. Each of these require strategic thinking and operational execution. 

As a GRC Engineer, you will get hands-on experience in the Trust field by developing your skills across numerous impactful operational tasks, in turn contributing to the strategy and evolving maturity of our Trust posture. 

Responsibilities

  • Work under the guidance of seasoned GRC experts and gain exposure to a range of cross-functional programs and processes, both technical and business-centric.
  • Enhance our GRC Engineering program, including building automations to improve compliance evidence collection, monitoring, and reporting dashboards.

title: Startups Account Executive
locations: New York, New York, United States
descriptionHtml:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team.

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive, you will be working with founders, co-founders, C-Suite Executives, controllers, and VP’s of Finance to continue generating net-new revenue and growing the Brex brand. You will manage a full pipeline and ensure success on every level.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Close net new business with a focus on professionally funded companies
  • Become trusted account advisors by managing accounts and being strategic in both inbound and outbound sales
  • Engage with businesses at all points of the sales cycle - including prospecting, product demonstrations, onboarding, and close.
  • Develop strategic plans on how to close more companies and generate more revenue
  • Focus on self-development with daily training and enablement
  • Work closely with Startups Ambassadors to bring in referrals

Requirements

  • 18+ months of Outbound B2B SaaS Sales experience, including 6+ months of closing experience
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota, President's Club, or top 10% of your team
  • Comfortable running discovery and closing conversations with C-suite decision makers
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $122,026 - $152,533. The starting wage will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. The OTE figure listed here includes base salary and commissions, which may or may not be earned depending on performance.  Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Where you'll work

This role will be based in one of our Brex offices — San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, or Salt Lake City. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work.

Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Sales Execution: Own the end-to-end sales process from outbound prospecting to discovery, product demos, and closing deals.
  • Pipeline Generation & Management: Consistently source and qualify leads to maintain a strong, reliable pipeline.
  • Value-Based Selling: Clearly communicate ROI and business value by understanding each prospect's goals and aligning Brex’s solutions to their needs.
  • Customer-Centric Problem Solving: Build trust through insight and service, helping prospects navigate challenges and unlock growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales Development, Product, and Underwriting to create a smooth and impactful buyer experience.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of closing experience in B2B SaaS sales, ideally in a high-volume or new business-focused role
  • A high-performing SDR/BDR background with a strong track record of sourcing and qualifying opportunities due to high self-prospecting requirements in role
  • Strong ability to communicate value and ROI to small or mid-sized business stakeholders
  • Consistent quota attainment and a history of top-tier performance
  • A proactive, self-motivated approach with a focus on results and customer impact

Bonus points

  • Familiarity selling financial software (Expense Management, ERP, AP Automation, T&E, Accounting Software, Banking, etc.)

Compensation

Engineering at Brex

Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

What you’ll do

The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.

As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.
  • Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.
  • Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.
  • Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.
  • Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.
  • Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.
  • Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.

Requirements

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.
  • You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.
  • You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.
  • You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.
  • You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.
  • You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.
  • You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.

Bonus points

  • You have worked on identity and access management, authentication, authorization, or audit systems in a production environment.
  • You have hands-on experience with Okta, Oso, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, or WebAuthn.
  • You have experience building enterprise-facing admin controls, authorization platforms, delegated access flows, or audit trails.
  • You have worked on platform teams that provide shared infrastructure, paved roads, or secure-by-default frameworks for other engineering teams.

locations: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
descriptionHtml:

We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Operations at Brex

Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.

What you’ll do

Brex is building the operating system for growing companies, and reliable funds movement is at the core. As a Banking Operations Analyst on our Domestic Payments team, you will work the US payment rails (ACH,checks, domestic wires, stablecoin) and investigate returns and exceptions, and keep our customers’ money moving accurately and on time. You’ll combine precision and rigor in controls with cross-functional collaboration to keep customers’ funds safe, timely, and accounted for. If you meet most, but not all, of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Work the domestic payments queue across ACH, checks, domestic wires and stablecoin, resolving cases in Salesforce with clear, customer-safe explanations.
  • Monitor ACH and wire returns, interpreting return codes and running the right procedure for each.
  • Watch for trends before they become incidents and escalate with clear context and urgency.
  • Work exceptions with external banking partners, bringing the right identifiers and evidence to speed resolution.
  • Keep the queue healthy by maintaining Salesforce routing and hygiene, balancing case quality and attention to detail.
  • Write and maintain documentation (SOPs, training materials) and help onboard and cross-train new analysts.
  • Leverage data and AI (Hex, SQL/Snowflake, Retool, LLMs) to investigate cases faster, build monitoring and dashboards, and automate repeat work.
  • Identify process gaps, determine whether each is a manual error, data break, or process gap, and bring clear requirements to Engineering and Product.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CX, CSMs, AEs, Accounting, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Design, and external banking partners to resolve exceptions and prepare for new flows.
  • Participate in the coverage rotation on some holidays for urgent cases.

Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or operations (CX/Support, Operations, or Treasury) at a fintech, broker-dealer, or bank. Relevant internships count.
  • Exposure to payments, returns, reconciliations, or settlements.
  • Strong control discipline: follows SOPs, maintains audit-ready documentation, and escalates anomalies with clear context.
  • Clear communicator and high-velocity collaborator under time pressure: responsive, decisive, and highly effective at partnering cross-functionally with CX, Engineering, Accounting, Compliance, and banking partners to drive swift resolutions.
  • Proactive self-starter with strong communication skills and a commitment to continuous feedback and improvement.
  • AI-native operator mindset, using LLMs/copilots to draft SOPs, triage exceptions, and generate first-pass analyses with strong output validation.

Bonus points

  • 2+ years of experience in banking, fintech, payments, or operations (CX/Support, Operations, or Treasury) at a fintech, broker-dealer, or bank. Relevant internships count.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Economics or Information Systems. 
  • Working knowledge of ACH and NACHA rules, return codes, and the lifecycle of wires and checks (including Reg CC and UCC 4A basics).
  • Data fluency: intermediate Excel/Google Sheets (lookups, pivots) and comfort analyzing operational dashboards (e.g., Hex) to monitor volumes, returns, and exceptions.
  • Comfort with SQL/Python for operational analytics, building checks and alerts, or automating workflows (e.g., Retool, Zapier).
  • Experience with Salesforce case management and queue routing.
  • Exposure to audits or control testing
  • Experience with fraud, OFAC, or compliance-adjacent investigations.

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $58,700 - $73,375.  However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

descriptionHtml:

Marketing at Brex

The Marketing team tells the Brex story — turning product innovation into customer obsession. We develop messaging, shape the brand, and bring our platform to life through thoughtful, compelling content. Our team spans Revenue Marketing, Product Marketing, and Brand Marketing, and works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Business Development, and Design to drive growth and build trust.

What you’ll do

Brex is seeking a deeply analytical, growth-rooted Senior Growth Marketing Manager to own, scale, and optimize our Paid Social engine, with Meta as the core growth driver and a clear mandate to test and scale emerging channels.

In this role, you will be accountable for down-funnel pipeline, efficient CAC, and customer acquisition. You won't just optimize campaigns; you will engineer signal architecture, build scalable audience models, and establish a high-velocity creative testing engine. Critically, you know how to build brand through a performance lens, connecting upper-funnel investments to near-term impact and long-term value creation. You’ll help accelerate Brex’s growth by scaling what works, continuously improving how we operate, and unlocking new opportunities for impact.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. Team members are expected to work in-office three days per week (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays). Brex also offers the flexibility to work remotely for up to four weeks per year, in one-week increments.

Responsibilities

  • Growth & Pipeline Ownership: Own Meta + emerging channel budgets, CAC efficiency, conversion, and downstream pipeline/revenue across self-serve and sales-led motions.
  • Signal & Measurement Strategy: Partner with Data and Marketing Ops to improve conversion signals, CAPI, and offline conversion tracking, enabling platforms to optimize toward higher-quality customers.
  • Structured Experimentation: Build and execute a continuous, hypothesis-driven testing framework across audiences, bidding strategies, optimization events, landing pages, and creative concepts; document learnings to turn paid social into a predictable acquisition channel.
  • Full-Funnel Growth: Build paid social strategies that create demand at the top of the funnel and efficiently convert it through retargeting and lower-funnel programs.
  • Creative Strategy: Translate performance data into creative hypotheses and partner with Brand and Design to test, iterate, and scale winning concepts.
  • Audience Strategy: Use first-party data, intent signals, modeled audiences, lookalikes, and platform automation to identify and scale high-value audiences.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Analytics, Marketing Ops, Field / Events team, PMM, and Sales to connect paid social performance & programs to downstream pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of growth or performance marketing experience, with deep hands-on expertise managing and scaling Meta as a primary acquisition channel.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a paid social channel end to end, including strategy, budgets, forecasting, campaign architecture, optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Relentlessly analytical: Deep understanding of unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback periods), attribution modeling, and how to connect platform metrics directly to down-funnel business impact.
  • Experience running full-funnel paid social programs, from awareness/video and demand generation through conversion and pipeline.
  • Strong expertise in audience strategy and platform automation, including first-party audiences, lookalikes, broad targeting, retargeting, and automated campaign products.
  • Strong understanding of conversion signals and measurement, including Meta CAPI, server-side tracking, attribution, conversion-event strategy, and CRM/offline conversion data.
  • Demonstrated experience building structured experimentation roadmaps across creative, audiences, bidding, optimization events, and new platform capabilities.
  • Strong creative judgment and experience writing briefs and translating performance data into actionable creative recommendations.
  • Excellent communicator who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional partners across Brand, PMM, Design, Analytics, Engineering, Marketing Ops, and Sales.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in fin-tech marketing or marketing to finance professionals.
  • Familiarity with product-led growth or hybrid demand models.

Compensation

  • Define and own the operating model for partner management, including processes, decision rights, governance, documentation, and escalation paths.
  • Establish partner SLAs, KPIs, reporting cadences, and performance-review mechanisms; hold internal and external stakeholders accountable to them.
  • Build reporting that provides clear visibility into partner performance, operational health, volume, quality, incidents, risks, and opportunities.
  • Own fee reconciliation and related controls, ensuring partner invoices, contractual terms, payment calculations, and internal records are accurate and resolved on time.
  • Lead operational readiness for new partners, products, workflows, and program changes, including requirements, launch plans, testing, training, and post-launch monitoring.
  • Manage partner incidents and escalations, coordinate root-cause analysis, and drive durable corrective actions.
  • Identify process gaps and automation opportunities that improve partner experience, reduce manual work, and strengthen control quality.

title: Senior Director, Client Sales
locations: New York, New York, United States
descriptionHtml:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Sales at Brex

The Sales team is the driving force behind revenue at Brex, and every team member directly impacts our bottom line. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and expanding value across our portfolio. We celebrate individual accomplishments and team wins, with a high-performance culture rooted in execution, transparency, and collaboration.

What You’ll Do

As Senior Director, Enterprise Client Sales, you will lead Brex’s enterprise client sales organization, developing its Directors and building the team responsible for retention, card growth, and SaaS expansion across our largest customers. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, you will own segment performance and define a multi-product growth strategy for our enterprise customer base.

This second-line leadership role combines organization building with enterprise sales strategy. You will build and scale a team capable of selling new products to new buying groups within existing customers and telling a unified platform story across card, travel, and expense. You will strengthen the executive relationships, business reviews, qualification, business cases, and ROI needed to support new enterprise buying decisions.

You will translate strategy into clear account priorities, coverage decisions, manager expectations, and operating practices. Working closely with Customer Success, Product, Implementation, and Revenue Operations, you will coordinate the account teams and executive engagement needed to deliver customer and revenue outcomes. You will also bring a strong understanding of product capabilities and customer needs, helping prioritize the gaps that materially affect enterprise expansion.

Where You’ll Work

This role will be based in one of our offices in San Francisco, New York City, or Seattle. Our hybrid environment combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three days per week in the office—Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday. As a perk, we also offer up to four weeks per year of fully remote work. 

Responsibilities

  • Own Enterprise Net Revenue performance across retention and expansion, with clear accountability for card growth, SaaS adoption, gross retention, and churn prevention
  • Define and execute a multi-product enterprise growth strategy, prioritizing opportunities across products, buying teams, business units, and geographies
  • Lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Client Sales Directors, establishing clear expectations for hiring, seller development, account strategy, forecasting, and performance management
  • Build and scale the organization through thoughtful hiring, onboarding, and ramp plans that reflect customer opportunity and management capacity
  • Build a repeatable cross-sell motion across card, travel, and expense, enabling teams to identify new buying groups, develop champions, articulate platform value, and secure new product commitments within existing customers
  • Establish disciplined account coverage, prioritization, assignment, planning, pipeline inspection, renewal planning, and forecasting practices, with clear ownership and accountability across account teams
  • Coach Directors and their teams to lead executive business reviews, develop C-suite relationships, communicate a unified platform and product-roadmap story, and build credible business cases and ROI for expansion opportunities
  • Build a structured executive engagement program that connects Brex leaders with priority customers, with clear objectives, preparation, account-team responsibilities, and follow-through
  • Establish an effective shared-account operating model with Customer Success, aligning responsibilities for retention risk, expansion opportunities, renewal planning, customer engagement, and value delivery
  • Develop a prioritized view of product gaps blocking enterprise expansion. Challenge and refine requests with the sales organization, distinguish critical capabilities from desirable additions, and bring a focused, evidence-based set of priorities to Product
  • Partner with Implementation and Customer Success to align commercial commitments with product capabilities, implementation readiness, adoption, and customer outcomes
  • Work with Revenue Operations and Enablement to improve revenue visibility, manager effectiveness, and the team’s ability to sell across card and SaaS products
  • Build a culture of ownership, high standards, collaboration, and accountability while developing leaders who can sustain performance as the organization grows

Requirements

  • 10+ years of B2B sales experience, including substantial enterprise software experience and a demonstrated record of delivering revenue results
  • 3+ years of experience managing frontline sales leaders in a second-line leadership role, with measurable results delivered through the management team
  • Demonstrated success building or materially scaling sales organizations, including recruiting strong talent, developing managers, and establishing effective onboarding and ramp practices
  • Experience defining a commercial growth strategy and translating it into account priorities, coverage decisions, manager expectations, and measurable outcomes
  • Strong enterprise sales judgment and a clear approach to multi-product cross-selling, including new buying groups, executive business reviews, C-suite relationships, business cases, and complex decision and procurement processes
  • Expertise in MEDDIC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology, with the ability to coach leaders on qualification, champion development, business-value articulation, and ROI
  • Strong operating and analytical rigor in coordinating enterprise account teams, establishing executive engagement and account-planning frameworks, assigning ownership, and holding teams accountable for customer and revenue outcomes
  • Strong product fluency and sufficient technical depth to understand capabilities and constraints, assess the commercial significance of product gaps, and prioritize critical expansion requirements with Product and sales stakeholders
  • Effective cross-functional leadership, including substantive partnership with Customer Success and teams responsible for implementation, adoption, and customer value delivery
  • Clear communication, executive credibility, and the ability to align senior stakeholders and internal account teams around shared priorities, decisions, and follow-through
  • Experience leading both enterprise new business and existing-customer growth is particularly valuable. Enterprise new-business leaders should demonstrate a strong approach to executive business reviews, CSM partnership, and cross-selling within existing accounts. Experience in fintech, spend management, or selling to Finance organizations is helpful

Compensation

The expected OTE range for this role is $316,400 - $395,500. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors, including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
